label: Ground Pound
description: Slam downward from the air with impact damage

parameters.label: Pound cooldown (frames)
parameters.help: Frames before you can move after landing from a pound.

parameters.label: Damage on impact
parameters.help: Damage dealt to enemies when landing. 0 = no damage.

parameters.label: Require key release between pounds
parameters.help: Player must release down key before triggering another pound.
